meta.name: business-case
meta.description: Develop a business case for an initiative using costs, benefits, risks and evidence. Use when a sponsor needs budget or timeline justification.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理成本、收益与风险,产出可提交的立项论证去申请预算
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你要向决策人争取项目预算或排期,却拿不出完整的成本收益依据
copy.tagline_en: Build a cost-benefit-and-risk case to justify budget or timeline to decision-makers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must win budget or timeline approval and need a solid cost-benefit case.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会针对某一项计划,依据成本、收益、风险和证据整理出一份商业论证,供出资方说明预算或时间安排的理由。
howto.when: 当出资方需要预算或时间安排的理由,或你要求为某项计划做商业论证时触发;若由 @fde 调用,则沿用其当前范围,不重新开始。

say.text: 帮我为这个项目做一份商业论证,写清成本和收益。
say.note: 产出以成本、收益为主的论证。

say.text: 把这份商业论证里的风险和证据补齐。
这个计划要申请预算,给我能支撑时间表的论证。
say.note: 面向预算与时间安排的论证。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude builds a business case for an initiative from its costs, benefits, risks, and evidence, so a sponsor can justify budget or timeline.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a sponsor needs budget or timeline justification, or when you ask for a business case. If called by @fde, it reuses that current scope rather than restarting.

say_en.text: Draft a business case for this initiative, covering costs and benefits.
say_en.note: Produces a case centred on cost and benefit.

say_en.text: Fill in the risks and evidence sections of this business case.
We need budget approval; give me a case backing the timeline.
say_en.note: Case aimed at budget and timeline.
